Good Morning Denis,

We truly apologize for the delay.

Due to the Eid holiday, we are currently unable to follow up directly with the finance team regarding your deposit refund. As per our system, the refund request has already been raised; however, it is still pending with the finance department.

We have highlighted your request as urgent and will provide you with an update on Saturday. We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding.

Thank you.
